# chadcn

> Phlex components that port shadcn/ui 1:1 (same names, same Tailwind classes, same data-slot markup) with Stimulus behavior (`chadcn--*` controllers). Compound components nest their parts (`Dialog::Content`) and also yield a root with one helper per part.

chadcn is a Ruby gem (RubyGems only). Not affiliated with shadcn. Built on shadcn/ui (MIT).

Generated by `rake llms:generate` from the YARD docs and the Stimulus controllers. Do not edit by hand.

## Docs

- [Full component reference](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt): every component with constructor keywords, variants, parts, Stimulus controller, events and an example
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/skills/chadcn/SKILL.md): short usage rules for AI assistants
- [README](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/README.md): installation and setup
- [Docs index](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/docs/README.md): the per-family guides
- [API conventions](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/docs/api-conventions.md): keyword arguments, `as_child`, yielded-root helpers, theming

## Components

- [Accordion](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-accordion): shadcn Accordion over Radix Accordion.
- [Alert](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-alert): shadcn Alert: a callout box with an optional leading `svg` icon (a direct child, styled by the classes), `Alert::Title` and `Alert::Description`.
- [AlertDialog](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-alert-dialog): shadcn AlertDialog (Radix AlertDialog, always modal).
- [AspectRatio](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-aspect-ratio): shadcn AspectRatio over Radix AspectRatio: a box that keeps a width/height `ratio` and positions its content to fill it.
- [Attachment](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-attachment): shadcn Attachment: an uploaded-file chip with a `state` (idle, uploading, processing, error, done).
- [Avatar](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-avatar): shadcn Avatar over Radix Avatar: a round user picture that shows its `Avatar::Fallback` until the `Avatar::Image` has loaded.
- [Badge](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-badge): shadcn Badge: a small status label.
- [Breadcrumb](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-breadcrumb): shadcn Breadcrumb (new-york-v4).
- [Bubble](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-bubble): shadcn Bubble: one chat bubble.
- [Button](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-button): A clickable button, the shadcn `Button` with its variant and size tables.
- [ButtonGroup](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-button-group): Groups related buttons into one joined control (shadcn `ButtonGroup`).
- [Calendar](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-calendar): shadcn `Calendar` (new-york-v4), which wraps react-day-picker 10.
- [Card](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-card): shadcn Card: a bordered surface.
- [Checkbox](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-checkbox): A checkbox: a `<button role="checkbox">` plus the hidden form input Radix renders.
- [Collapsible](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-collapsible): shadcn Collapsible over Radix Collapsible.
- [Combobox](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-combobox): shadcn Combobox (Base UI `Combobox`, not Radix).
- [Command](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-command): shadcn Command (the React-only `cmdk` library).
- [ContextMenu](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-context-menu): shadcn ContextMenu (Radix ContextMenu over the Menu code shared with DropdownMenu).
- [Dialog](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-dialog): shadcn Dialog (Radix Dialog).
- [Direction](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-direction): shadcn/ui Direction over Radix Direction.
- [DropdownMenu](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-dropdown-menu): shadcn DropdownMenu (Radix DropdownMenu + Menu).
- [Empty](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-empty): shadcn Empty: the empty-state block (no results, nothing here yet).
- [Field](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-field): A form field: lays out a label, a control, a description and an error (shadcn `Field`).
- [HoverCard](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-hover-card): shadcn HoverCard (Radix HoverCard).
- [Input](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-input): shadcn `Input` (new-york-v4).
- [InputGroup](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-input-group): Wraps an input with leading or trailing addons, buttons and text (shadcn `InputGroup`).
- [InputOtp](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-input-otp): shadcn InputOTP (the React-only `input-otp` 1.5.0 library).
- [Item](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-item): shadcn Item: a flexible list row (media, content, actions).
- [Kbd](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-kbd): shadcn Kbd: a keyboard key cap (`kbd`), optionally grouped with `Kbd::Group`.
- [Label](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-label): shadcn/ui Label over Radix Label.
- [Marker](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-marker): shadcn Marker: a timeline/chat divider line with an optional `Marker::Icon` and `Marker::Content`.
- [Menubar](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-menubar): shadcn Menubar over Radix Menubar + Menu: a horizontal bar of menus, each opened from a `Trigger`.
- [Message](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-message): shadcn Message: one chat message row.
- [NativeSelect](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-native-select): shadcn NativeSelect (new-york-v4).
- [NavigationMenu](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-navigation-menu): shadcn NavigationMenu over Radix NavigationMenu.
- [Pagination](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-pagination): shadcn Pagination (new-york-v4).
- [Popover](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-popover): shadcn Popover (Radix Popover).
- [Progress](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-progress): shadcn Progress over Radix Progress.
- [RadioGroup](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-radio-group): shadcn RadioGroup over Radix RadioGroup.
- [ScrollArea](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-scroll-area): shadcn ScrollArea over Radix ScrollArea (Root, Viewport, Scrollbar, Thumb, Corner).
- [Select](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-select): shadcn Select (Radix Select).
- [Separator](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-separator): shadcn Separator over Radix Separator: a thin horizontal or vertical rule.
- [Sheet](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-sheet): shadcn Sheet (Radix Dialog with side-aware styling).
- [Sidebar](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-sidebar): shadcn Sidebar (new-york-v4).
- [Skeleton](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-skeleton): shadcn Skeleton: a pulsing placeholder box; size it with `class`.
- [Slider](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-slider): Single component with no nested parts: the track, range, thumbs and hidden inputs (one per thumb) are rendered internally.
- [Sonner](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-sonner): shadcn/ui Sonner (the Toaster wrapper of shadcn, over the sonner library).
- [Spinner](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-spinner): shadcn Spinner: a spinning `loader-circle` icon (`role="status"`, label "Loading").
- [Switch](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-switch): A toggle button with `role=switch`, plus a hidden checkbox so it submits with a form.
- [Table](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-table): shadcn Table.
- [Tabs](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-tabs): shadcn Tabs over Radix Tabs.
- [Textarea](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-textarea): shadcn `Textarea` (new-york-v4).
- [Toggle](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-toggle): A two-state button (`aria-pressed`).
- [ToggleGroup](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-toggle-group): shadcn ToggleGroup over Radix ToggleGroup.
- [Tooltip](https://github.com/doncan-orozco/chadcn/blob/main/llms-full.txt#component-tooltip): Root of the Tooltip family; must be rendered inside a `Tooltip::Provider`.
